name: Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer
wookieepedia_title: Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Death Star III)
description: This Imperial-class Star Destroyer was one of three that participated in the Battle of Death Star III. The ship caught a wayward Star Tours StarSpeeder 3000 in its tractor beam during the battle, but Alliance of Free Planets starfighters helped the spaceliner escape.
